text_block_list.text:
Super Creek shuts Oguri Cap out with<n>a tenacious
run, seizing the victory for<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek has won race after race<n>intent on
earning me the title of "best<n>trainer in the world."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to make this dream a reality,<n>the next race
she chooses to run in<n>is... the Arima Kinen!
